data.name: Amankumar
data.gender_notes: Amankumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amara meaning 'Immortal' and KumaR meaning 'Lord or Ruler'. This name signifies the immortal and powerful God who bestows his grace upon us. The name Amankumar carries the meaning “God's Grace and Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Amankumar usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine presence of Lord Amara, the immortal God, who protects and guides us in our life journey.
data.etymology: Amankumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace and Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amankumar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Amankumar" is rooted in the belief in the immortal God who rules and bestows his grace upon his followers. data.spiritual_symbolism: Amankumar: The embodiment of immortality and victory. Amanku signifies immortality, while Kumar represents the victorious warrior. Together, they form the name Amankumar, inspiring a sense of invincibility and eternal life.
